notes: No Element or Ultima trade-in or competitive-replacement program was found. https://www.elementbiosciences.com/promotions returned 404. Two standard searches (Element AVITI trade-in/NovaSeq credit; Ultima UG100 trade-in/price guarantee) returned only old launch coverage and total-cost-of-ownership claims. There were no archive.ph snapshots, and I did not spend calls trying them. The one useful find was a Tampere University-hosted Element AVITI EURO price list (V7, created 12 Nov 2025, modified 2 Apr 2026). It is a list price, not a trade-in offer. It leans against 1B, because Element's own list $/Gb is far above Illumina's 25B price.
how_to_mine: Low payoff, so don't deep-mine. If anyone does: (1) search archive.org/archive.ph for elementbiosciences.com/promotions, /aviti-trade-in and /compete; (2) search Ultima's site for 'UG 100 Solaris' and 'trade-in' pages; (3) look for other university procurement pages that host Element or Ultima price lists (tuni.fi, other .edu and .fi domains) to build a list-price time series. Element's Trinity and Cloudbreak Ultra Q price rows could also be compared with the Illumina X price lists.

items.label: 1B
items.claim: Element's own AVITI list prices (Nov 2025, EUR) are about €5.6-11/Gb, so Element is not undercutting Illumina's 25B at list price on its Cloudbreak kits.
items.detail: Element AVITI EURO price list V7 (Nov 2025, modified Apr 2026, list includes shipping): 2x150 FS High Output €1,676.51 for 300 Gb (€5.59/Gb). 2x75 High is €1,077.75 for 150 Gb (€7.19/Gb). 2x300 High is €1,876.09 for 180 Gb (€10.42/Gb). Ultra Q 2x150 is €2,674.43 for 240 Gb (€11.14/Gb). Library prep (Elevate €648.65) is excluded. Compare Illumina's 25B list of about $2.1-4.5/Gb and core-level $2.5-3.1/Gb, and the Broad Clinical Labs claim of Ultima at about $0.50 per M reads. Element's discount leverage therefore depends on VITARI (H2'26, about $1.00/Gb claimed) and negotiated deals, not on current list prices. This suggests the AVITI pricing gap that large accounts can use is mainly a promise about future products.
items.source_name: Tampere University (tuni.fi) hosted Element AVITI EURO 2025 price list V7
items.why_new: This is a primary Element list-price table with a $/Gb calculation per kit. The known list had only core-level AVITI figures (Northwestern, UMN).
